name: Keep From Falling
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of human failure, as a righteous person may fall multiple times yet rises again, while the wicked fall into ruin. This hope is grounded in the power of God, for with Him nothing is impossible, and through Christ believers are strengthened to overcome challenges. Ultimately, God alone is able to keep His people from falling and present them blameless before His glorious presence, reminding us of our need for His sustaining grace despite our universal sinfulness.
